title: An item touching provider.py gets the tested rules of the docs its touches map to
goal: Retrospective of SP-sbdy4hsx: the ST-7zkw23ca worker ran rag.py pack --root _self --item ST-7zkw23ca and got coverage none, so its brief carried no tested rule for provider.py, providers.csv or web-sources.md. kb/_self/map.csv maps _tools/provider.py and _tools/providers.csv to their docs, and those docs have tested questions in kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv (how provider.py read reports a page that is not text, where a fetch is cached), so the item pack prints them.
links: closed by: ST-qb25367f, if its tested _self rows cover provider.py and kbid.py
notes: Merged from ST-matmgqai “rag.py pack --item gives rules for land, procs and selfcheck items instead of coverage none” at the 2026-10-12 draft triage: Reproduces: item pack of a land-touching item gives coverage none with the right passages printed, and its check pack is weak. Same defect as ST-a4sqcsfn (item pack by touches via map.csv gets coverage none); ST-a4sqcsfn is the broader mechanism. Its goal: Retrospective of SP-lyfnpu37: the ST-iltxwoty worker got coverage none from rag.py pack --root _self --item for an item touching bl_land.py, bl_procs.py and bl_selfcheck.py and read the Landing, Processes left running and Self-check sections by hand; the BG-dnojxemz worker's item pack printed 'not in kb: st-ocfkanth'. An item pack for such touches names the tested rule questions of those sections. Its checks: {"run": ["python3", "-c", "import subprocess,sys;p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self','how long does land wait for a finished session-end hook before it refuses a worktree'],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(0 if 'coverage: good' in p.stdout else 1)"]} Its touches: _tools/rag.py, kb/_self/backlog.md Evidence from ST-qb25367f (2026-10-16): with six tested _self rows for kbid.py add and provider.py read in lookup_eval.csv, rag.py pack --root _self --item ST-wiv62ohc and --item ST-2t73jxfk still print coverage none (no tested question matches). The item pack prints the right passages (tools.md:26, tools.md:36, content-rules.md:54, web-sources.md:7 and :10) with no [tested ID] mark. Cause: the item's title and goal are the question, and kbfacts.tested_matches needs TESTED_SHARE (75%) of its 70 or 22 key words in one tested question. A pack asked with a short question ('how long does provider.py read keep a fetched page') reports good with the tested mark. So the rows deliver the rule text, not a good verdict for a long goal.
